chunks: And Aban narrated from Zurarah that he said:
I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام say: "If a man kills during a sacred month, he must fast for two consecutive months from the sacred months."

key_terms.أَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ: the sacred months recognized in Islamic law
key_terms.شَهْرٍ حَرَامٍ: a sacred month in which certain violations carry added gravity
key_terms.شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ: two consecutive months of fasting without interruption
key_terms.صَامَ: he fasted; here, fasting as a legal expiation

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for killing in a sacred month according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning expiation connected to killing in a sacred month. It states that when a man kills during one of the sacred months, he must fast two consecutive months, and those months are to be from the sacred months.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5203 - Aban narrated from Zurarah, who said:
I heard Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say, "If a man kills during a sacred month (haram month), he must fast for two consecutive months from the sacred months."
